description: The 29 October 2026 morning brief, which still printed one company's results several times after the 28 October grouping fix: Capri Global's two reports of its results were split from the results filing because they quote different figures (standalone Rs 353 crore against consolidated PAT Rs 418 crore, and a FY28 growth target), and Sasken's results were filed under five subjects that the grouping pass left apart. Headlines, subjects and times are the captured rows; the press release's read facts are the edition's printed summary; URLs and publishers are fixture placeholders. The controls are constructed to prove what must stay separate. Model replies in offline tests are fixtures, not a live accuracy evaluation.
